subject: Email verification and password reset
body:
Closes the two honest gaps the portal was apologising for.

- Signup now mails a verification link (24h, single use). The portal shows
  the real state and can resend, throttled to 5 an hour per address.
- /auth/forgot issues a 2-hour reset link and answers identically whether or
  not the address has an account, including for a malformed address and when
  throttled, so it cannot be used to find out who is registered.
- Token lookups are scoped by purpose. Without that, a verification link -
  which is a weaker secret, sent on every signup - could have been replayed
  at /set-password to take over the account.
- Setting a password still drops every other session.
- One shared email template, with all author-controlled text escaped before
  it reaches the HTML body.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
